applies_to: Honeywell SOLA (R7910/R7911) integrated boiler controls, status registers 0-173 of the SOLA Modbus Interface specification Rev 4.1.1 (2013-10-14). Used inside many OEM condensing boilers.
summary: SOLA is Honeywell's integrated burner and hydronic control used by many boiler OEMs. Its RS-485 Modbus RTU port exposes everything as 16-bit holding registers, with digital signals packed into bit-map registers. This map covers the status area: change flags, digital I/O, limits, demand source, temperatures, firing rate, flame signal, burner control status and lockout codes, sensor states, CH/DHW/lead-lag status and pump status.

addressing.note: The specification says register addresses start at 0 per the Modbus specification; add 40001 to the decimal address for traditional 4xxxx numbering. Register 7 (outlet temperature) is requested as address 7 (40008).

source.title: Software Interface Specification - SOLA Modbus Interface
source.pages: physical layer pp. 13-14; function codes and register rules pp. 14-15; addressing p. 18; status registers pp. 18-31

notes: Source host: Honeywell's specification as hosted by Contemporary Controls (a Honeywell integration partner); Honeywell does not host it publicly that we could find.

All temperatures are in 0.1 °C regardless of the display unit setting. The specification lists these registers as U16 even though the range is -40 to 130 °C; check how sub-zero values arrive on site. A temperature that does not apply (function not enabled) reads 0x8FFF; sensor faults replace the reading with the codes in table 4 of the source (0x7FFF, 0x8000-0x8500).
Firing-rate type registers carry either RPM or a 0.1 % value; the most significant bit tells which (0 = RPM, 1 = %), as set by the modulation output parameter (register 192).

Left out: the 32-bit statistics counters (128-147); the specification says 32-bit items use two consecutive registers but does not state the word order. Also left out: configuration registers above 173, alert/lockout history, lead-lag slave tables and the variable-length data items.
Pump status coding depends on application build (before/after 1600); see tables 13-14 in the source.
Up to 125 registers per read and 20 per write; variable-length items must be read on their own.

integration.summary: Connect to the SOLA's 3-pin RS-485 Modbus port (38400 8N1) and read holding registers with FC 03 from address 0. Temperatures are 0.1 °C integers; burner status is at 32, lockout code at 34.
integration.enable: Use one of the SOLA's RS-485 Modbus ports (MB1 or MB2); the control answers to a single Modbus address. Register writes are limited by the access level shown in register 19 (none, installer, OEM or all).
quirks: Status-change registers 0, 1 and 23 clear when read.
Digital signals are bits inside holding registers, not coils.
setup: Fixed format: 38400 bps, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
gotchas: OEM boilers may disable or relabel some SOLA functions; confirm with the boiler maker's documentation.
0x8FFF in a temperature register means that function is not enabled; 0x7FFF and 0x8000-0x8500 are sensor fault codes.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
